reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's Gold's Gloom with its ending on the Self-defeating Forethought page: the dig, the failed leap, the desertion and the bamboo blow.

Names (ಹಿರಣ್ಯಕ, ಲಘುಪತನಕ, ಮಂಥರ), the lake frame and the unnamed traveller-monk are consistent with ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗೆಳೆಯರು and ಎಳ್ಳಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ, which is named rather than retold; neither monk carries a sect marker.
Age band 12+: the cat kills some of the follower mice in one calm sentence and the blood becomes small drops, both disclosed.
The pause question comes before the hoard is revealed. Small wording fixes after review. No em dashes.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; one Codex gpt-5.6-sol generation, no edits, seams exactly at x=512 and y=512/1024; no text.
No cat, wound, blood or blow is drawn; when the mouse misses the pot it only tumbles in a puff of dust.

The two monks wear plain brown and grey robes with no sect or caste markers; the mouse, the grey troop, the hanging pot and the bamboo stick stay consistent; the frame panel shows the crow and the turtle listening by the lake.
Three alt texts were corrected after review to match the pictures.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels; edited panels were re-checked by a separate agent.
